extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners and patent applicants/registered practitioners (agents/attorneys) preparing nucleotide/amino acid sequence disclosures
extracted.subtask_description: Requirements and examiner form-paragraphs for preparing, adding, or replacing Sequence Listings and computer readable forms (CRFs) in patent applications disclosing nucleotide and/or amino acid sequences under 37 CFR 1.821–1.825 and related MPEP guidance. Covers acceptable formats, required statements, amendment procedures, and corrective responses to common defects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement for a "Sequence Listing" (37 CFR 1.821(c))
rubrics_metrics.description: "37 CFR 1.821(c) requires that patent applications which contain disclosures of nucleotide and/or amino acid sequences ... must contain a 'Sequence Listing,' as a separate part of the disclosure, which presents the nucleotide and/or amino acid sequences and associated information using the symbols and format in accordance with the requirements of 37 CFR 1.821-1.825."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Sequence Listing must be a separate part of the disclosure and use the symbols/format required by the cited regulations. If an application includes sequence disclosures that meet the definitions in 37 CFR 1.821(a), a Sequence Listing part is mandatory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptable formats for Sequence Listing
rubrics_metrics.description: The 'Sequence Listing' part of the disclosure may be submitted: (a) as an ASCII text file via the USPTO electronic filing system, (b) on read-only optical disc(s), (c) as a PDF file via the USPTO electronic filing system, or (d) on physical sheets of paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When submitted as ASCII text, specific incorporation-by-reference requirements apply (see related rubric). Submission as PDF or paper is 'not recommended' in some places and triggers CRF requirements. Read-only optical discs must be labeled according to 37 CFR 1.52(e)(5).

rubrics_metrics.name: ASCII text file metadata and incorporation paragraph requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: When submitted as an ASCII text file under 37 CFR 1.821(c)(1), the specification must include an incorporation-by-reference paragraph identifying: (i) the name of the ASCII text file; (ii) the date of creation; and (iii) the size of the ASCII text file in bytes (see § 1.77(b)(5)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The incorporation paragraph must be a separate paragraph of the specification and should replace any prior such paragraph as applicable. If the ASCII file was filed on the application filing date without the incorporation paragraph, the specification must be amended to include it (subject to exceptions for international applications).

rubrics_metrics.name: When ASCII file serves as both Sequence Listing and CRF, incorporation required in specification
rubrics_metrics.description: If the 'Sequence Listing' is filed as an ASCII plain text file only, thereby serving both as a 'Sequence Listing' under 37 CFR 1.821(c) and a CRF under 37 CFR 1.821(e), then an incorporation by reference statement is required in the specification (replacing any prior such paragraph) (see 37 CFR 1.77(b)(5)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This rule avoids separate CRF submission when the ASCII text file fulfills both roles, but still mandates the specification incorporate the file by reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Placement requirement for PDF or paper Sequence Listings
rubrics_metrics.description: If the 'Sequence Listing' is filed as a PDF image file or on physical sheets of paper, then the 'Sequence Listing' must be placed after the abstract of the disclosure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This placement requirement applies to PDF or paper submissions of the Sequence Listing (37 CFR 1.821(c)(2) and (c)(3)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Computer Readable Form (CRF) requirement when listing submitted as PDF or paper (37 CFR 1.821(e), 1.824)
rubrics_metrics.description: When a 'Sequence Listing' is submitted as a PDF file or on physical sheets of paper, a computer readable form (CRF) of the 'Sequence Listing' is required in accordance with the requirements of 37 CFR 1.824 and 1.821(e).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If listing is submitted as PDF or paper, the applicant must provide a CRF (typically an ASCII text file) and related statements per §1.821(e). Failure to submit a CRF or submission of a defective CRF triggers examiner form paragraphs requiring correction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement that CRF content and Sequence Listing are identical
rubrics_metrics.description: If the 'Sequence Listing' required by 37 CFR 1.821(c) is filed as a PDF, paper, or on read-only optical disc, then 37 CFR 1.821(e)(1)(ii) or 1.821(e)(2)(ii) requires submission of a statement that the 'Sequence Listing' content of the PDF/paper/disc copy and the CRF copy (ASCII text file copy) are identical.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This statement of identity must accompany CRF submission when the primary listing is not itself the ASCII CRF. Missing this statement is a specific deficiency (see ¶24.06, ¶24.05, ¶24.07).

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements when adding a Sequence Listing after filing date (37 CFR 1.825(a))
rubrics_metrics.description: Adding a 'Sequence Listing' after the application filing date involves submission of: (1) a 'Sequence Listing' in an accepted form, (2) a request that the amendment be made by incorporation (for ASCII) or inserting text (for PDF/paper), (3) a statement indicating the basis for the amendment in the application as originally filed, (4) a statement that the 'Sequence Listing' includes no new matter, (5) a new or substitute CRF when the submission is a PDF/paper, and (6) a statement that the sequence information in the CRF is the same as in the added 'Sequence Listing' when required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See MPEP § 2428 for sample statements. If ASCII text is used and also serves as CRF, incorporation-by-reference in the specification is required. If PDF/paper is used, the listing must be placed after the abstract and may require a separate CRF and identity statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements when replacing/amending a Sequence Listing (37 CFR 1.825(b))
rubrics_metrics.description: Amending the 'Sequence Listing' involves submission of a replacement 'Sequence Listing' in an accepted form, together with statements that: identify the location of all deletions, replacements, or additions to the 'Sequence Listing'; indicate the basis for the amendment in the application as originally filed; and state that the replacement 'Sequence Listing' includes no new matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If replacement is ASCII, an incorporation paragraph in the specification is required. If replacement is PDF/paper, the replacement must be placed after the abstract and, if a separate CRF was not submitted/compliant/same-as-listing, a new/substitute CRF and a statement of identity are required. Replacement of a read-only optical disc must be by replacement disc and must include all original unamended files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement that Sequence Listing includes no new matter
rubrics_metrics.description: Any addition or replacement 'Sequence Listing' must be accompanied by a statement that the 'Sequence Listing' includes no new matter (37 CFR 1.825(a)(4) / 1.825(b)(5)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This follows current practice for substitute specifications (37 CFR 1.125) and is required whether adding or replacing. Missing this statement is a specific deficiency (see ¶24.15).

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement indicating basis for amendment with specific references
rubrics_metrics.description: Any amendment to sequence data must include a statement that indicates the basis for the amendment, with specific references to particular parts of the application (specification, claims, drawings) as originally filed (required for all amended sequence data in replacement 'Sequence Listing').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This statement supports that the amendment is supported by the original disclosure; missing or insufficient statements trigger specific deficiency form paragraphs (see ¶24.14, ¶24.16).

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement identifying locations of deletions/replacements/additions in replacement Listing
rubrics_metrics.description: A replacement 'Sequence Listing' submission must include a statement that identifies the location of all deletions, replacements, or additions to the 'Sequence Listing' (required by 37 CFR 1.825(b)(3)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This aids examination and must be specific; sample statements available in MPEP § 2428.

rubrics_metrics.name: New or substitute CRF required when PDF/paper replacement and prior CRF not submitted/compliant/different
rubrics_metrics.description: If the replacement 'Sequence Listing' is submitted as a PDF file or on physical sheets of paper and a separate CRF under 37 CFR 1.821(e) was either not submitted, not compliant with 37 CFR 1.824, or not the same as the submitted 'Sequence Listing', then a new or substitute separate CRF is required along with a statement that the sequence information contained in the CRF is the same as the sequence information contained in the replacement 'Sequence Listing' (37 CFR 1.825(b)(6)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When submitting a replacement disc that originally included multiple files, the replacement disc must include all original unamended files to preserve access to all current files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Read-only optical disc replacement must include all original files
rubrics_metrics.description: If the 'Sequence Listing' required by 37 CFR 1.821(c) was filed on a read-only optical disc that included files in addition to the 'Sequence Listing', a replacement read-only optical disc containing the amended 'Sequence Listing' also must contain all of the files of the original read-only optical disc that were not amended.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This ensures the Office, printer, and public can quickly access all current files by referencing only the latest version. Replacement must be by replacement disc (37 CFR 1.52(e)(7)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Minor sequence-rule errors may be deferred to next Office action
rubrics_metrics.description: Minor errors pertaining to compliance with the sequence rules discovered after examination has begun may be handled with the next Office action. Examples include missing sequence identifiers in the specification/drawings; missing or incomplete incorporation-by-reference of the 'Sequence Listing' in the specification (if required); and missing statement that the sequence information in the 'Sequence Listing' is identical to the CRF.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the application is otherwise ready for examination, the examiner may act on the application and include objections related to minor sequence errors in the Office action rather than immediately issuing a non-final rejection. Form paragraphs for defects should be used only where a compliant Sequence Listing is not required for examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form paragraph ¶24.02 — No Sequence Listing part and No CRF (specific deficiency & required response)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific deficiency: application does not contain a 'Sequence Listing' as a separate part of the disclosure or a CRF of the 'Sequence Listing'. Required response: Applicant must provide a 'Sequence Listing' part of the disclosure; an amendment specifically directing its entry into the application per 37 CFR 1.825(a)(2); a statement that the 'Sequence Listing' includes no new matter (1.825(a)(4)); and a statement indicating support for the amendment (1.825(a)(3)). If submitted under certain items, also provide a CRF and the statement of identity per item 2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This form paragraph must be preceded by form paragraph 24.01 and is to be used only where a compliant Sequence Listing is not required for examination. It may be followed by additional deficiency form paragraphs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form paragraph ¶24.03 — No Sequence Listing and Defective CRF (specific deficiency & required response)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific deficiency: application lacks a 'Sequence Listing' and the CRF is defective. Required response: provide a 'Sequence Listing' part as described in item 1), an amendment directing its entry (1.825(a)(2)), a statement of no new matter and support; and if listing is submitted per items 1)a or b, also provide a substitute specification inserting required incorporation paragraph (marked-up and clean versions) and statement the substitute contains no new matter; if submitted per items 1)c or d, provide a CRF and the identity statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This paragraph must be preceded by 24.01 and is only for cases where a compliant Sequence Listing is not required for examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improper CRF transfer request disallowed (¶24.17)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific deficiency: application contains a 'Sequence Listing' submitted as PDF or physical paper but no CRF has been received, and applicant filed a request to transfer the CRF from a related or other application. As of November 15, 2021, the practice of transferring a CRF from a previously-filed application of applicant into the present application to comply with 37 CFR 1.821(e)(1) has been eliminated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must submit a proper CRF for the present application; CRF transfer requests are no longer acceptable to cure absence of a CRF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form paragraph ¶24.05 — Sequence Listing and CRF must be the same (specific deficiency & required response)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific deficiency: the 'Sequence Listing' part submitted as a PDF or on physical sheets is not the same as the CRF as required by 37 CFR 1.821(e)(1)(ii) or (e)(2)(ii). Required response: either (A) provide a replacement 'Sequence Listing' and associated amendment, statements identifying locations of changes, statement of no new matter, and statement indicating support, plus confirmation the previously-filed CRF is identical to the added listing; OR (B) provide a new CRF and a statement that the CRF content is identical to the previously-submitted listing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where a text file was originally submitted (1)a or b), the text file will serve as the CRF and the identity statement is not required. Precede with form paragraph 24.01.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form paragraph ¶24.06 — Missing statement that the listing (paper/PDF) and the CRF are the same
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific deficiency: application lacks the statement that the CRF is identical to the 'Sequence Listing' part of the disclosure as required by 37 CFR 1.821(e)(1)(ii) or 1.821(e)(2)(ii). Required response: Applicant must provide such statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This paragraph must be preceded by 24.01 and is used only where a compliant Sequence Listing is not required for examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form paragraph ¶24.07 — No Computer Readable Form (CRF) submitted
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific deficiency: application contains a 'Sequence Listing' as a PDF file or physical sheets but fails to submit a CRF as required by 37 CFR 1.821(e)(1)(i) or 1.821(e)(2)(i). Required response: provide a new CRF in accordance with 37 CFR 1.821(e)(1)(i) or 1.821(e)(2)(i) and a statement that the content of the CRF is identical to the 'Sequence Listing' part of the disclosure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Precede with form paragraph 24.01; used only where a compliant Sequence Listing is not required for examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form paragraph ¶24.08 — CRF contains errors according to STIC report
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific deficiency: CRF is defective per STIC report. Required response: provide a replacement 'Sequence Listing' and amendment directing its entry, statement of no new matter and support; if submitted under items 1)a or b provide a substitute specification with incorporation paragraph (marked-up and clean versions) and statement no new matter; if replacement submitted per 1)c or d provide a CRF in accordance with 1.821(e)(1) or (2) and statement of identity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This paragraph must be preceded by 24.01 and used when the CRF is defective; bracketed insertion of the date of the appropriate document is instructed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form paragraph ¶24.09 — CRF damaged or unreadable
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific deficiency: ASCII .txt file purported to be the CRF has been found damaged, unreadable, or contains an error. Required response: provide a replacement 'Sequence Listing' as an ASCII plain text file (37 CFR 1.825(b)(1)(i)) and amendment directing entry, statement of no new matter and support, and either a substitute specification or a 'Sequence Listing' part of disclosure per 1)c/1)d. When listing is provided per 1)c/1)d, applicant must also provide a CRF in accordance with 37 CFR 1.821(e)(1) and the identity statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used for damaged/unreadable CRF situations (e.g., SCORE - CRF Problem Report); must be preceded by 24.01.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form paragraph ¶24.10 — Sequence identifiers (SEQ ID NO:) missing in specification
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific deficiency: nucleotide and/or amino acid sequences appearing in the specification are not identified by sequence identifiers in accordance with 37 CFR 1.821(d). Required response: provide a substitute specification inserting the required sequence identifiers, consisting of a marked-up version, a clean version, and a statement that the substitute specification contains no new matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when reference has not been made to the sequence by 'SEQ ID NO:' in the description or claims, even if embedded in the text. Precede with 24.01.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form paragraph ¶24.11 — Sequence identifiers missing in drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific deficiency: sequences appearing in the drawings are not identified by sequence identifiers in accordance with 37 CFR 1.821(d). Required response: provide replacement and annotated drawings inserting required sequence identifiers and/or a substitute specification inserting identifiers into the Brief Description of the Drawings (clean and marked-up versions with statement of no new matter). If listing submitted per items 1)b, c, or d, also provide a replacement CRF and statement that the substitute specification contains no new matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sequence identifiers must appear either in the drawings or in the Brief Description of the Drawings. Precede with 24.01.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form paragraph ¶24.12 — Sequences in spec/drawings not in CRF or listing
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific deficiency: application contains sequence disclosures in the specification or drawings that are not contained in the Sequence Listing or CRF. Required response: provide a 'Sequence Listing' part of the disclosure as described in item 1) and the statement(s) according to item 2)a or b) (CRF identity statements as applicable).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bracketed insertion of the specific location in the application where sequences are not contained in the Sequence Listing/CRF should be provided. Precede with 24.01.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form paragraph ¶24.13 — Missing or defective incorporation-by-reference paragraph
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific deficiency: the incorporation-by-reference paragraph required by 37 CFR 1.821(c)(1) is missing or incomplete. Required response: provide a substitute specification inserting the required incorporation-by-reference paragraph, an amendment directing entry of the 'Sequence Listing' into the application per 1.825(b)(2), a statement that the 'Sequence Listing' includes no new matter (1.825(b)(5)), and a statement indicating support for the amendment (1.825(b)(4)). If listing submitted per 1)a or b, include statement that the substitute specification contains no new matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when the incorporation paragraph is missing for a Sequence Listing under 1)a or 1)b. Precede with 24.01.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment must direct entry of the Sequence Listing into the application (¶24.14)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific deficiency: the amendment does not direct entry of either the 'Sequence Listing' (as required by 37 CFR 1.825(a)(2) or 1.825(b)(2)) or contain the required incorporation-by-reference paragraph into the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required response typically includes a substitute specification inserting the incorporation paragraph and an amendment specifically directing entry; preceded by 24.01.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment must include a statement of support (¶24.16)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific deficiency: the 'Sequence Listing' has not been entered into the application because the required statement of support is missing. See 37 CFR 1.825(a)(3) or 1.825(b)(4). Required response: Applicant must provide a proper statement of support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This form paragraph must be preceded by 24.01 and is used when the statement of support for the amendment is missing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment must include a statement of no new matter (¶24.15)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific deficiency: the 'Sequence Listing' has not been entered into the application because the required statement of no new matter is missing. See 37 CFR 1.825(a)(4) or 1.825(b)(5). Required response: Applicant must provide a proper statement of no new matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This paragraph must be preceded by 24.01; provide the explicit statement that no new matter is introduced by the listing or amendment.
